title: Cambyses of Xerxes line
summary: Raleigh names Cambyses of Xerxes line in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cambyses, named between Achaemenes and Cyrus in the line by which Xerxes, in the seuenth of Herodotus, deriueth himselfe. He is not Cambyses the father of Cyrus the Great, and not the Cambyses who succeeded him. The one-word title would fold onto cambyses, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
